title: A percent minimum on a card whose close day is "not sure": the day's interest first (decisions K1 and K2)
story: One bank, set up Fri 20 Nov 2026 with 500,000. One card paid from it: the close day is not sure (H4) and it carries a balance at 12% a year. It is paid on the 10th, moved later on weekends, and its minimum is 5% of what is owed, at least 3,000. At setup 100,000 is owed. The December minimum is paid on its day; 10,000 is spent on the card on 15 Dec; the January payment (Sun 10 Jan, so Mon 11 Jan) is not seen. K1: the interest of a payment day is on everything owed before that day's payment, as on a loan. K2: with a percent minimum, the day's interest is added first and the minimum is worked out on the balance including it. I2: interest is balance x yearly rate / 12, rounded half up to the yen; a 5% minimum is rounded to the nearest yen. No income and no holidays are listed. Every amount and rate is made up.

opening.note: No statement typed; the close day is not sure.

cc.why: 105,950 (95,950 after the December payment + 10,000 spent 15 Dec) x 12 / 100 / 12 = 1,059.5, rounded half up

asks.question: card_due
asks.why: 5,050 (5% of 101,000: the 100,000 owed plus the 1,000 interest added first on 10 Dec) = 5,050
asks.note: K2: the day's interest is added before the percent minimum is worked out. Before K2 the model asked 5% of 100,000: 5,000.

asks.question: due_before_next_pay

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.note: No fixed pay: the walk reaches 45 days ahead (4 Jan); the January payment is after it.

asks.question: owed_now
asks.why: 100,000 (owed at setup) + 1,000 (interest at the 10 Dec payment day) - 5,050 (paid 10 Dec) = 95,950

asks.question: card_due
asks.why: 4,846 (5% of 96,910: the 95,950 owed plus 960 interest on 11 Jan, 959.5 rounded half up; 4,845.5 to the nearest yen) = 4,846

asks.question: card_due
asks.why: 5,351 (5% of 107,010: the 105,950 owed after the 15 Dec spend plus 1,060 interest on 11 Jan, 1,059.5 rounded half up; 5,350.5 to the nearest yen) = 5,351
asks.note: K1: the interest is on everything owed before that day's payment, the 15 Dec spend included. Before K2: 5% of 105,950, 5,298.

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 5,351 (Card, all owed, due Sun 10 Jan, lands Mon 11 Jan) = 5,351
asks.note: The next 30 days run to 14 Jan.

asks.question: owed_now
asks.why: 95,950 (owed after the December payment) + 10,000 (spent 15 Dec) + 1,060 (interest at the 11 Jan payment day on 105,950, 1,059.5 rounded half up) = 107,010
asks.note: K1, the model's reading confirmed: the 15 Dec spend carries interest on the next payment day. On the other reading (only what was left from the payment day before) the interest would be 960: 106,910. The January payment has not been seen; the interest is added on its day all the same.
